why: removes 2 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: The two removed handlers moved where 1.21.2+ draws them: renderClouds HEAD is CloudRendererMixin on CloudRenderer.render (mixin_add from 1.21.3) and renderSky TAIL is GlobalSkyboxHook on RenderLevelStageEvent.AfterSky, both in the prepared 1.21.8 tree, while renderEntity HEAD/RETURN stay.

why: deletes overriding method(s) getGLVersion, loadingOverlay, positionWindow, setupMinecraftWindow: whatever they did is gone -- port each to the new API, or say why vanilla no longer needs it
reviewed: The provider's only effect is its static initialiser (kept), which FML 9 still runs because it instantiates every ImmediateWindowProvider service; the deleted getGLVersion/loadingOverlay/positionWindow/setupMinecraftWindow were inert stubs of methods FML 9's interface no longer has.
